name: productsgroup-create
description: A product group creation skill based on the Tradebee Website Builder Open API. It is used to create a new product group under a specified site language, with support for parent group, group name, tags, and brief description.

language.description: Required. Exact site language code to publish into, such as `en` or `fr`. Do not guess or translate it. First call `languages-get`, show the language list to the user, then copy one exact `language` value the user confirms.

productsgroup.description: Required. Complete product group payload for the new published product group.

parent_productsgroup_id.description: Optional. Parent group ID. Omit this field or set `0` to create a top-level group. If provided, select one exact `productsgroup_id` from `productsgroup-read`.

group_name.description: Required. Product group name, up to 200 characters.

tags.description: Required. Provide 1 to 6 unique keyword tags. Each tag must contain 3 to 50 characters.

brief_description.description: Optional. Short plain-text description, up to 4,000 characters.

confirmation.description: Required. Proof that the user explicitly approved this exact product group creation request after seeing the final language and payload.

approved.description: Must be `true` only after the user explicitly confirms the language and exact product group payload to be created. Never set this to `true` based on assumption.

summary.description: Required confirmation note that restates the language and exact product group payload shown to the user before execution.

status.description: Request status. `true` indicates success and `false` indicates failure.

url.description: Preview URL for the created product group page. Always return this to the user and ask the user to preview it.

productsgroup.parent_productsgroup_id.description: Omit this field or set it to `0` to create a top-level group. If creating a child group, select a parent group ID from `productsgroup-read` under the same language.
